notes: Caps for every metered budget, by date. scripts/ops.ts budgets reads this file and sets the profile that covers today. Run it every day, because a day bucket whose window has ended refuses every call until it is rolled.

These are starting numbers. Retune them on key day once Qloo's real quota is known, then run budgets again: a new cap takes effect at once, while used and the window end stay as they are until the window ends.
A profile covers its from date up to, but not including, its to date, in UTC. Profiles may touch but must not overlap.

qloo:month is the hard ceiling for every Qloo call, from the site, the agent and the offline scripts alike. The day buckets only spread that month out. qloo:day is the share for live runs on the site. qloo:day:offline is the share for the backtest and the seed script, which still count against the same month and the same per-second limit.

The judging reserve comes from the split across the two profiles. October keeps the public share low (300 a day) because few visitors come before judging, and gives the offline share room (4,000 a day) so the backtest can be pulled in a day or two. November spreads its month over the judging days (2 to 16 Nov): 600 a day for the public, 500 a day offline for reruns and seeding.
anthropic:day:offline is the model-token share for the backtest title reads (about 500 tokens a title), kept apart from anthropic:day so a data pull never uses up the tokens live runs need.
anthropic:day counts model tokens and youtube:day counts YouTube Data API units. Google's free daily quota is 10,000 units, so 9,000 leaves a margin for calls made outside this meter.

Judging month. The public share doubles and the offline share shrinks to reruns and seeding.
